description: This file defines a repository interface for accessing ProductToGLAccountMapping entities in a Spring Data JPA context. It includes custom query methods to retrieve mappings based on various product and account attributes.

classes.name: ProductToGLAccountMappingRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for ProductToGLAccountMapping entities, with numerous custom query methods for retrieving account mappings based on product and account attributes.

methods.name: findByProductIdAndProductTypeAndFinancialAccountTypeAndPaymentTypeId
methods.description: Finds a ProductToGLAccountMapping by product ID, type, financial account type, and payment type ID.

methods.name: findProductIdAndProductTypeAndFinancialAccountTypeAndChargeId
methods.description: Finds a product-to-GL account mapping based on product ID, type, financial account type, and charge ID.

methods.name: findCoreProductToFinAccountMapping
methods.description: Finds a core product to financial account mapping where certain fields are null.

methods.name: findAllPaymentTypeToFundSourceMappings
methods.description: Retrieves all mappings for a product's fund source with specific financial account type.

methods.name: findAllFeeToIncomeAccountMappings
methods.description: Retrieves all fee income account mappings for a product.

methods.name: findAllPenaltyToIncomeAccountMappings
methods.description: Retrieves all penalty income account mappings for a product.

methods.name: findByProductIdAndProductType
methods.description: Finds all mappings for a given product ID and type.

methods.name: findAllChargeOffReasonsMappings
methods.description: Finds all mappings associated with charge-off reasons for a product.

methods.name: findAllProductToGLAccountMappingsByProductIdAndProductTypeAndFinancialAccountType
methods.description: Finds all mappings for a product with a specific financial account type.

methods.name: findAllWriteOffReasonsMappings
methods.description: Finds all mappings related to write-off reasons for a product.

methods.name: findChargeOffReasonMapping
methods.description: Finds a mapping associated with a specific charge-off reason.

methods.name: findAllRegularMappings
methods.description: Finds all mappings that are considered regular (without specific attributes).

methods.name: findAllPaymentTypeMappings
methods.description: Finds all mappings with a payment type for a product.

methods.name: findAllPenaltyMappings
methods.description: Finds all penalty-related mappings for a product.

methods.name: findAllFeeMappings
methods.description: Finds all fee-related mappings for a product.

methods.name: findAllCapitalizedIncomeClassificationsMappings
methods.description: Finds all mappings with a capitalized income classification.

methods.name: findAllBuyDownFeeClassificationsMappings
methods.description: Finds all mappings with a buydown fee classification.

methods.name: findBuydownFeeClassificationMapping
methods.description: Finds a mapping with a specific buydown fee classification.

methods.name: findCapitalizedIncomeClassificationMapping
methods.description: Finds a mapping with a specific capitalized income classification.

methods.name: findWriteOffReasonMapping
methods.description: Finds a mapping with a specific write-off reason.
